tests.name: a chat session in a repo kb knows searches only its origin's source, from the tool, the palette, each message and warm-up
tests.why: fake kb records --source=app for tool, palette, message and warm-up; title quotes the MUST's chat case and callers

tests.name: a task try and a run worker in AMC's worktrees folder search the origin's source, not the worktree
tests.why: worktree sessions search the origin's source; title quotes the MUST's worktree case

tests.name: a repo kb does not know runs no search and records outside once; each switched-on special repo adds its source, and one switched off leaves the next search
tests.why: unknown repo, one and two switches on, switch off mid-session; title quotes those cases

tests.name: a wiki hit never reaches a session with the wiki off: a result that lands after the switch, a hit linked into it, and a note opened from an older list
tests.why: late result after switch-off, symlinked hit and note-file read all refused; the MUST's two cases

tests.name: a message sent with the wiki off attaches no wiki hit, though kb answers with one
tests.why: a wiki hit kb returns is not attached to the message when the wiki is off

tests.name: the Azure DevOps tool follows the origin: offered in a task worktree of an in-scope repo, refused for an out-of-scope one, on create and after resume
tests.why: fake ADO with a scoped pack, worktree tries in and out of scope, before and after a restart; title quotes the MUST's cases

tests.name: a session gets the tool only when Azure DevOps is set up and the work pack covers its folder
tests.why: unchanged base test guarding a chat session in scope and a pack with no scope.json (everywhere, as today)

tests.name: a scope folder spelled through a link covers the real folder a session's origin is stored as, and the other way round
tests.why: inScope now compares real paths, needed because origins are stored as real paths

tests.name: when kb cannot list its sources, a session still sends, searches nothing, and kb's health says why
tests.why: malformed output and timeout of the sources listing: session keeps working, no search, health names the reason; title paraphrases the MUST closely

tests.name: Check again, with kb failing, has the next search read kb's source list afresh
tests.why: recovery path of the sources list after failure (Check again)

tests: tests/unit/kb-scope.test.ts::a wiki hit never reaches a session with the wiki off: a result that lands after the switch, a hit linked into it, and a note opened from an older list
findings.note: After the fix, revocation of cached notes was tested for prompts, steers and subagents but not for fork, hand-off or the Cursor engine; a missing case, which a fail-on-base check of the existing tests cannot reveal.

tests: tests/unit/kb-scope.test.ts::a task try and a run worker in AMC's worktrees folder search the origin's source, not the worktree
findings.note: The worktree test switches nothing on, so origin-plus-switched-source in task and worker sessions is unasserted; the test passes either way, so fail-on-base checking would not flag the gap.

notes: Head includes s2's commits, so e2e, actions, server and task-loop changes belong to s2; no browser test was added for these MUSTs. knowledge.test.ts and analytics.test.ts changes only adapt fakes to the new sources listing. MUST 4's 'kb missing' case has no test (review noted a pre-existing gap there). The TD-2 test 'kb's source list is read again when its sources file changes, or on Check again (TD-2)' is tech debt, not a MUST.
